reviews.text: I used Alex for several years but his prices have become outrageous. I started at 60 dollars, then $80 last year and $100 today without any notification of a price raise. I drive 30 minutes one way because of his prices, but I think I can find someone closer to the house for the same price.  He had a sign that says if you have a problem with the price raise, let him know so he can work something out. When I told him that I couldn’t afford the price raise, he exploded which is not like Alex at all.  Maybe he’s had a lot  of complaints, I don’t know. I do know that this is not his usual behavior. I do know I will not be going back.  I will look for something more reasonable closer to the house. His attitude stunk today and my feelings are hurt.  I’ve never been disrespectful and I am always pleasant. I hope whatever is bothering him gets better
Alex is the best. Took care of Milo and now Messi.
Weird, called for information and to make an appointment, but the receptionist just hung up on me. Very terrible, sad because they are very close to me.
Been taking Darling for a while for her wash and trims. Very friendly. She loves Alex.

Could not recommend this business more. They did a fabulous job with my 5 month old puppy’s first groom. It’s very obvious that they genuinely care about their clients. We will absolutely be coming back!!
Been going to Alex many years and he is amazing.

Alex is the best! Super friendly and the dogs always get a great cut. We have been about 5 times and we will be returning.

Update: Been going 2 years now and Alex is still the best! We saw Alex last week and the dogs look fantastic. Honestly I don’t care where I live in LA, I’ll probably just travel to take them here.

Reasonable price and great service.
I take my dog there all the time

I took my dog Suki for the first time, I had previous bad experiences at other groomers because my dog has really sensitive skin. But Alex The Happy Dog turned things around! They were able to use sensitive skin products and after the wash my dog looked and smelled the best I’ve ever seen her. I was really impressed.
My minnie schnauzer Nana is very difficult,  Alex is amazing.
Most dogs like Alex as much or more than their owners. Great guy. Great service.

Love Alex and his staff.
Professional service and my dog looks and smells great after grooming!
We always have a fantastic experience here. They are kind and the prices are great and my dog comes out looking like a brand new cutie! The best groomer.

Alex is amazing! He’s the first groomer our dog has ever been to in 8 years where he comes home happy and not traumatized. The prices are so reasonable and the service is relatively quick comparatively. Alex is so friendly and sweet and seems to genuinely love his job.
